lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements comes before the board — changes that touch how every building in this canyon gets built. Council also continues its work session on the Telluride Energy Mitigation program, while the Housing Authority moves to seat its new Resident Advisory Committee from fifteen tenant applicants across Town properties.
